fields.value: Make etude report rendering nearly free

Rendering an experiment's report page should cost almost nothing: it reads stored records and draws them, with no games or training. Today `etude report experiments/tla_trophies_floor.py --source r2://manabot/jobs/tla_trophies_floor` (run from the manabot checkout /Users/jack/src/manabot.mtg-408-floor-the-damped, branch jack/mtg-408-floor-the-damped-updates-reverse-kl-so-a-locked, with `doppler run -p manabot -c prd -- uv run --extra artifacts --extra reports --extra evaluation`) takes about 6-7 minutes and writes a 22 MB HTML page for 17 training runs and ~121 eval runs. The page is re-rendered every 40 minutes while an experiment runs, so this cost repeats.

Use this experiment's real records as the benchmark data. Candidates to measure, not conclusions: re-reading every training metric block and eval block from R2 on each render (no local cache of immutable sealed blocks); rebuilding the eval stats database from all blocks rather than only new ones; embedding every metric point of every run into the HTML.

Measure first: wall time by phase (fetch, stats build, page data, HTML write), bytes fetched, and page size by section. Make an unchanged re-render cost close to nothing and a full render as fast as the data allows. Keep the page's meaning identical: same panels, points and gaps.

A cProfile of one render is being taken in the manabot MTG-408 session; it will be shared by steer when it lands.
